chunks: With your Lord alone will be the retreat on that day.
ai.seo_question: Where is the final destination on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of the return to the Divine Source, serving as a reminder of ultimate accountability after the transient nature of worldly life. It highlights that regardless of one's status, all creation must eventually face their Lord, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in the context of the Hereafter.
